_NOTE: Partial capture. Public state captured via Playwright browser_evaluate against the live SWE on staging during a real login flow. Doken capture deferred to the runtime warm-up (must be obtained mid-SWE-login; OIDC access_token is in-memory only on the Account Console after redirect; private localStorage bytes are intentionally not captured per the SWE error-reporting allowlist).

user._vuid_NOTE: The Tide-derived hash that TideCloak's first-broker-login screen populated as the auto-username. It's the SHA-256 of the user's CMK-derived identity (per the tide-IdP-extensions setup).
user._doken_NOTE: Capture during Playwright warm-up by intercepting the SWE-side return path. The Doken is the per-session credential the SWE produces on successful CMK auth; it is consumed by AuthorizedSigningFlow as `token` (string, opaque blob).
user._sessKey_NOTE: TideKey serialized form. tide-js TideKey methods (confirmed by introspection): get_private_component, get_public_component, sign, verify, asymmetricDecrypt, asymmetricEncrypt, prepVouchersReq. Only the PUBLIC component goes into the fixture; the private is per-session and ephemeral.
user._vvkid_NOTE: Extracted from the SWE URL query string `gVVK=...`. This IS the vvkid for tide-metrics-load realm — stable across all users in the realm.
user._vvkPublic_NOTE: Same as vvkid in this realm — gVVK on the URL is the vendor's public vault key. tide-js Point class (minified `E`) accepts it via fromHex / fromBase64; confirm during runSign wiring.
user._voucherURL_NOTE: The host part + path + clientId are stable; sessionId + tabId are per-login. Captured value during the test login: sessionId=utpldoi2GOTSu-lnyfbFpa7g, tabId=-cYh3E6JYNs.
user._orks_NOTE: activeOrks is populated by the SWE during the login flow (NodeClient.GetSomeORKs against the home ORK at /Network/Authentication/Node/Some). The SWE's tide-js cohort is whatever this endpoint returns — at staging time of capture, length=10 matching TOTAL_ORKS=10. Capture the full OrkInfo[] during the warm-up.

_signedSettings_NOTE: Captured from the SWE URL `signedSettings=...&settingsSignature=...`. Stable across all logins for the realm. The harness doesn't validate the signature — that's TideCloak's job — but it does need to know RegOn=true means registration is signed-on.
_swe_url_NOTE: These are the params TideCloak's TideIdentityProvider.performLogin redirect URL carries. All present per Phase-1 idp-extensions PM audit. authorizerPack is hex-encoded; the others are base64. The harness's warm-up should fetch these from the realm's IdP config (Realm Settings → Keys → tide-vendor-key Settings page) ONCE and stash them; for each enrolled user the cohort + per-session sid + voucherURL vary, but these REALM-level values are stable.
